title: One Missouri Restaurant Made America's 12 Most Haunted List
excerpt: A famous Missouri place has just been named one of the 12 most haunted restaurants in America.
content:
You don't often hear the phrases "fine dining" and "ghost hunting" mentioned together, but that's what's happened for a Missouri restaurant that has just been declared one of the 12 most haunted in America.

This is one of the most frightening buildings you'll find in St. Louis

This is, of course, the infamous Lemp Mansion, but if you zoom in on the sign to the right of the door, you'll see it's more than a mansion now.

Cheapism has just made the Lemp Mansion/Restaurant part of their 12 most haunted restaurants in America list. They note that what used to be the admittedly fancy dwelling place in that era for the Lemp family has now become a very much desired restaurant. Never mind the fact that above the dining area is the rooms that ghost hunters say are occupied by members of the Lemp family that never left (including their dog apparently).

I am a believer that "ghosts" are nothing more than evil entities messing with people, but that's just me talking. I know that many enjoy visiting the Lemp Mansion for its rich history and you can add fine food to that list now, too.
